
# Morgan Spencer - Software Engineering & Architecture

> The official personal website of Morgan Spencer, a lead software engineer focused on frontend architecture, reusable component systems, web accessibility, and modern web development.

Morgan Spencer's experience spans software engineering, web strategy, digital communications, digital marketing, and design. He earned an MBA from The Citadel and a bachelor's degree from Philadelphia University.

This is a single-page website. The links to Experience and Tech Stack below point to sections of the homepage, not separate pages.

## Website

- [Official website](https://spencer.dev/): Morgan Spencer's canonical personal website and professional overview.
- [Experience](https://spencer.dev/#experience): Professional experience, including his lead software engineering role at Booz Allen Hamilton and earlier roles at The Citadel, CBC Industries, and Sylogent, plus education and a broader timeline.
- [Tech Stack](https://spencer.dev/#stack): Technologies and interests including HTML, CSS, TypeScript, Web Components, web accessibility, React, Node.js, and AI.
